notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Friends! We've launched the first patch in which:
[list]
[*] Many bugs fixed (We hope - almost all of this little basterds)
[*] Windowed mode now playable.
[/list]

[i]"I (as the only programmer) want to apologize if you've had some annoying issues on your way. I really want to hope it's all in the past now.

I have no excuse! ːsteamsaltyː

But as I see from the reviews, many people were so generous to gave a positive review despite the bugs. Thank you so, so much!!! 

And have a good trip!" - [/i] Michael Rfdshir
